messages:
leo: Heads-up — launching the spring tiered pricing pilot Monday. Need cutover SOP, legacy protection rules, and vendor fee mapping before go.
maria: Thanks. Proposal: region-by-region stagger over 4 days (NA, EMEA, APAC, Rest). Keeps invoices stable and lets us watch FX effects.
ajay: Prefer size+region gating: start with small customers in NA, then expand. Also need guidance on billing spans that include the cutoff date.
samir: For spans, bill by event timestamp (usage time). That keeps unit economics correct. We'll add pre/post columns to the billing export.
jen_prod: Product suggests 10/90 A/B split (control=today's price, treatment=tiered) with 48h canary in each region. Feature flag ready: flag=spring_tiered_pilot.
maria: Approving 10/90. Grandfather baseline: customers created before 2026-03-01 keep old rate for 45 days. Exceptions for credits > $500 as manual opt-out.
vendor-ops: vendor-ops: passthrough OK in principle, need SKU parity table + contract addendum for pilot. We'll circulate clause draft.
leo: Billing ops: create manual adjustment playbook for any invoice drift > $1k. Also set refund buffer and hold for 72h before auto-refund.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-05 05:00 UTC (NA small segment) — gating checks enabled.
ajay: Reconciliation plan: run token-level compare between usage, billing export, and vendor report hourly for first 24h. If >0.5% invoices fail, pause rollout.
samir: I'll drop the export query here. Use this to seed the report:

```
SELECT acct_id, DATE(event_ts) as day, SUM(token_count) AS tokens_used, SUM(CASE WHEN tier='old' THEN charge ELSE 0 END) AS pre_charge, SUM(CASE WHEN tier='new' THEN charge ELSE 0 END) AS post_charge
FROM usage_events
WHERE event_ts >= '2026-04-04' AND event_ts < '2026-04-10'
GROUP BY acct_id, DATE(event_ts);
```

Compare to billing_export.csv and vendor_fee_report.csv.
maria: Who signs vendor fee mapping? @vendor-ops to confirm SKUs; finance sign-off after contract language finalized.
vendor-ops: We'll post SKU parity table by EOD and ping legal for the addendum.
jen_prod: If canary shows >2% revenue delta vs expected in NA small within 24h, trigger rollback to control and notify finance@squad + eng-oncall.
leo: Agreed. I'll enable invoice hold and manual review for canary accounts. Tagging #billing-escalations for any mismatches.
ajay: One operational ask — align cutoff to UTC midnight to simplify date math across regions. Anyone objections?
maria: Fine with UTC midnight. Update docs and CFO reporting template.
ops-bot: incident-bot: if >100 reconciliation failures within 2h OR median invoice latency > 45s, auto-escalate to oncall.
samir: Small ask — include both unit_rate_old and unit_rate_new in exports for downstream analytics and audit.
maria: Added to checklist. Final ask: everyone ack here when their task is done so we can flip the flag on Monday.
